fields.name: RefundApprovalSubmittedCase1
fields.fieldText:
Fee has been paid and URC has not been signed.

The required refund approval has been initiated and is currently pending.

Approval flow: CSO → Finance

Once the required approvals are completed:

  • The Opportunity will be marked as Closed Lost.
  • The Unit will be marked as Available.
  • Finance will process the Full Fee Refund.

No further action is required from you at this time.

fields.name: RefundApprovalSubmittedCase2
fields.fieldText:
Fee has been paid and URC has been signed.

The required refund approval has been initiated and is currently pending.

Approval flow: CSO → Finance


The Reservation Amount will be retained.

After approval:

  • If the amount paid is greater than the Reservation Amount, Finance will refund only the excess amount.
  • If the amount paid is less than or equal to the Reservation Amount, no refund will be processed.
  • The Opportunity will be marked as Closed Lost.
  • The Unit will be marked as Available.

No further action is required from you at this time.

fields.name: RefundApprovalSubmittedCase3
fields.fieldText:
Fee has not been paid and URC has not been signed.

The Opportunity closure request has been submitted for the required approval.


Approval flow: CSO

Once the CSO approval is completed:

  • The Opportunity will be marked as Closed Lost.
  • The Unit will be marked as Available.

No refund processing is required for this scenario.

No further action is required from you at this time.

fields.name: RefundApprovalSubmittedCase4
fields.fieldText:
Customer refuses to sign the SPA.

The required refund approval has been initiated and is currently pending.

Approval flow: Operations → CSO → Fin AR → EDT → CFO


Once all required approvals are completed:

  • The Opportunity will be marked as Closed Lost.
  • The Unit will be marked as Available.
  • Finance will process the Full Fee Refund.

No further action is required from you at this time.

fields.name: CRF_Required_Fee_Paid_URC_Not_SignedScreen
fields.fieldText:
Customer Refund Form (CRF) Required


The Customer Refund Form (CRF) has not been received for this Contract.


What This Means:

The closure and refund approval process cannot proceed without this document.


Next Steps:

  1. Ensure the customer has completed and signed the CRF form
  2. Have the Relationship Manager (RM) attach the CRF document to the Contract
  3. Update the "RES_CRF_Form_Received" field to TRUE
  4. Retry the Closed Lost process


No approval request has been submitted at this time.

fields.name: ErrorMessagae
fields.fieldText:
An Error Occurred


We encountered an unexpected error while processing your request.


What This Means:

The system was unable to complete the Closed Lost process due to a technical issue. No changes have been made to the Opportunity.


Next Steps:

  1. Take a screenshot of this message
  2. Contact your system administrator with the following details:
  • Opportunity ID: {!recordId}
  • Error Time: {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
  • Error Details: {!$Flow.FaultMessage}


Your administrator will investigate and help resolve this issue.

fields.name: Closeloss
fields.fieldText:
Invalid Close Date


The Opportunity Close Date is set to {!GetOpportunity.CloseDate}, which is in the past.


System Requirement:

The Close Date must be today or a future date when marking an Opportunity as Closed Lost.


Action Required:

  1. Update the Opportunity Close Date to today or later
  2. Retry the Closed Lost process


Current Close Date: {!GetOpportunity.CloseDate}

fields.name: SuccessMessage
fields.fieldText:
Approval Process Initiated


The closure and refund approval request has been successfully submitted and is currently pending approval.


What Happens Next:

Once all required approvals are completed:

  • The Opportunity will be marked as Closed Lost
  • The related Quote will be marked as Cancelled
  • The related Contract will be marked as Cancelled
  • The Units will be released and marked as Available
  • Refund processing will be initiated (if applicable)


No further action is required from you at this time.

screens.name: Opportunity_Closed_Successfully_for_All_Quote
screens.label: Opportunity Closed Successfully for All Quote

fields.name: Copy_1_of_SuccessMessage
fields.fieldText:
Opportunity Closed Successfully


The Opportunity has been successfully marked as Closed Lost.


Completed Actions:

  • Opportunity status updated to "Closed Lost"
  • Associated Units have been released and marked as Available
  • Reason for Loss recorded: {!Reason_for_lost}


The Opportunity closure process is complete.

fields.name: ApprovalAlreadyInProgressMessage
fields.fieldText:
Approval Process Already In Progress


An approval is currently pending for this Contract.


What This Means:

A closure and refund approval request has already been submitted and is awaiting approval. You cannot submit a new approval until the current one is completed.


Current Approval Status:

  • Status: Pending


Next Steps:

  1. Check the "Approval Work Items" related list on the Contract
  2. Contact the assigned approver if you need to expedite the approval
  3. Wait for the current approval to be completed before retrying


No new approval request has been submitted.

fields.name: CannotCloseOpportunity
fields.fieldText:
Cannot Close Opportunity as Lost


This Opportunity is currently in the "{!GetOpportunity.StageName}" stage.


System Rule:

Opportunities that are already in "Closed Won" or "Closed Lost" stage cannot be changed to Closed Lost again.


Next Steps:

If you need to modify this Opportunity, please contact your administrator.


Current Stage: {!GetOpportunity.StageName}
